_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Data_SecretNotes.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

1.chinese: 这是阿比盖尔日记中的一页^^“我喜欢的事物：雕刻南瓜的香气、在我的枕头下放块紫水晶、巧克力蛋糕、香辣鳗鱼的刺激，以及妈妈做的黑莓脆皮饼带来的慰藉（我爱吃！）”%revealtaste:Abigail:276%revealtaste:Abigail:66%revealtaste:Abigail:220%revealtaste:Abigail:226%revealtaste:Abigail:611
1.english: This is a page from Abigail's diary: "Things I like: the fragrance of carved pumpkins, putting an amethyst under my pillow, chocolate cake, the thrill of spicy eel, and the comfort brought by the blackberry cobbler Mom makes (I love eating it!)"

10.chinese: 有人^    在^      头骨山洞^      的^      第 100 层^      等你……
10.english: Someone is waiting for you on level 100 of the Skull Cavern...

1001.chinese: 第 1 天^^……我的船没了……它在暴风雨中被无情的大海摧毁了。^^我现在被困在这片陌生的海岸上。我的船员都去世了，只有我还活着。也许幸运女神保佑了我这把恶事做尽的老骨头……也有可能她对我的命运还有其他的安排。^^不管怎样，我别无选择，只能在这个地方过日子了。有充足的淡水，有食物可以采集，有肥沃的土壤可以耕种……^^首先我得建一个住处……^^（有几页缺失了）
1001.english: Day 1. ...My ship is gone... it was destroyed by the merciless sea in a storm. I am now trapped on this strange shore. My crew have all died; only I am still alive. Perhaps Lady Luck protected these old bones of mine that have done every evil deed... or it's also possible she has other plans for my fate. Whatever the case, I have no choice but to live in this place. There's plenty of fresh water, there's food to gather, there's fertile soil to farm... First I must build a dwelling... (Several pages are missing)

1002.chinese: 第 6 天^^我在这里再也不会挨饿了……水里全是可以吃的（不对，是很美味的！）鱼。^^我甚至在东南海岸的洞穴里抓到了一条黄貂鱼。不过我不知道该怎么处理！^^前些日子，我甚至捞到了几个金色核桃。它们似乎遍布全岛。当地的鹦鹉抢疯了！
1002.english: Day 6. I'll never go hungry here again... the water is full of edible (no, delicious!) fish. I even caught a stingray in a cave on the southeast coast. But I don't know what I should do with it! A few days ago, I even fished up a few golden walnuts. They seem to be all over the island. The local parrots are going crazy grabbing them!

1003.chinese: 第 14 天^^在这个岛上待了半个月后，我对如何找到这些金色坚果已经略懂门道了。^^必须要睁大眼睛寻找微小的线索，如果有什么东西看起来不同寻常，那附近可能就有个隐藏的坚果。^^我发现沙子里有……树叶里也有……^^我甚至在火山附近的一棵树上看到了一个坚果。可惜我没办法把它打下来……^^每次我发现有坚果的植株时，总能找到方法去够到它。
1003.english: Day 14. After staying on this island for half a month, I've got a rough knack for how to find these golden nuts. You must open your eyes wide to look for tiny clues; if something looks unusual, there may be a hidden nut nearby. I found them in the sand... in the leaves too... I even saw a nut in a tree near the volcano. Too bad I had no way to knock it down... Each time I found a plant with nuts, I could always find a way to reach it.

1005.chinese: 第 23 天^^当地的火山埋藏着许多秘密。^^我看到眼睛发光的小人，在黑暗里四处蹦跳，就像夜里的猫……^^（他们是不是 M·贾思博在他的《闻名之旅》里提到的矮人？）^^我还看到有奇怪的机器，怪异离奇，不像是人类已知的东西。^^在山顶，我找到了一条通往火山口的通道。还有，半淹没在冒泡的熔岩中，有一台奇特的机器……是一种“锻造炉”。 ^^我明天会继续调查。
1005.english: Day 23. The local volcano hides many secrets. I saw little people with glowing eyes hopping about in the dark, like cats in the night... (Are they the dwarves M. Jasper mentioned in his "Famous Journey"?) I also saw strange machines, bizarre and outlandish, not like anything known to humans. At the summit, I found a passage leading to the crater. Also, half-submerged in bubbling lava, there's a peculiar machine... it's a kind of "forge". I'll continue investigating tomorrow.

1007.chinese: ——锻造表——^^黄水晶 —— 防御^绿宝石 —— 速度^翡翠 —— 暴击能量^海蓝宝石 —— 暴击几率^紫水晶 —— 击退^红宝石 —— 伤害^^五彩碎片 —— 附魔^^备注：武器可以用宝石锻造三次，也可以用五彩碎片附魔一次。^^备注 2：“固有附魔”（获得武器时自带的属性）可以使用龙牙来增加或刷新。据推测，一定品质之上的武器无法获得此类附魔。^^工具只能附魔，不能锻造。
1007.english: —Forging table— Topaz — defense; Jade — speed; Emerald — crit power; Aquamarine — crit chance; Amethyst — knockback; Ruby — damage. Prismatic shard — enchant. Note: a weapon can be forged with gems three times, and can also be enchanted once with a prismatic shard. Note 2: "Innate enchantments" (attributes a weapon comes with when obtained) can be added or refreshed using dragon teeth. Presumably, weapons above a certain quality can't get this kind of enchantment. Tools can only be enchanted, not forged.

1008.chinese: ——武器附魔——^^巧妙：能让你更快地做出“特殊动作”。^^虫子杀手：对虫子造成更多伤害。^^吸血：偶尔能从怪物身上吸取生命。^^十字军：对“邪恶”怪物造成更多伤害。^^干草：割杂草时，你会得到更多的纤维，也有几率获得干草。^^——工具附魔——^^强力：对石头、树木等造成更多工具伤害。^^范围：增强蓄力能力，作用范围更大。^^木屑：砍树时有几率获得额外的木材。^^无底洞：喷壶永远不会干涸。^^丰富：能从地下挖出更多东西。^^考古学家：有更高几率发现文物和骨头。^^省力：使用不费体力。^^迅捷：更快地挥动工具。^^精通：提升钓鱼等级。^^自动上钩：鱼咬钩时自动开始钓鱼。^^耐用：有 50% 的几率不消耗鱼饵和渔具。
1008.english: —Weapon enchantments— Artful: lets you do "special moves" faster. Bug killer: does more damage to bugs. Vampiric: occasionally drains life from monsters. Crusader: does more damage to "evil" monsters. Haymaker: when cutting weeds, you get more fiber, and also have a chance to get hay. —Tool enchantments— Powerful: does more tool damage to stones, trees etc. Range: boosts charging ability, larger area of effect. Shavings: chance of extra wood when chopping trees. Bottomless: the watering can never runs dry. Generous: can dig more things out of the ground. Archaeologist: higher chance of finding artifacts and bones. Efficient: using costs no energy. Swift: swing tools faster. Master: raises fishing level. Auto-hook: fishing starts automatically when a fish bites. Preserving: 50% chance of not consuming bait and tackle.

1009.chinese: 那是一个阴雨天，我看见美丽的少女孤独地坐在岩石之上。^^传说有海的女儿们歌唱海妖之歌，^但是她却拼不出半个音符……^^第二天早上，我发现满是泡沫的岸上有一排石头……^——————————^对……有一分钱硬币那么大的石头，也有五分钱那么大的……^——————————^要是我这副老嗓子能吼出什么曲调，也许她能带领我去寻找黑海鸥的宝藏……
1009.english: It was a rainy day; I saw a beautiful maiden sitting alone atop a rock. Legend says the daughters of the sea sing the siren's song, but she couldn't piece together half a note... The next morning, I found a row of stones on the foam-covered shore... Yes... there were stones as big as a one-cent coin, and some as big as five cents... If this old throat of mine could bellow out some tune, maybe she could lead me to search for the Black Gull's treasure...

1011.chinese: 第 37 天^^我十岁的时候，父亲给了我一个光辉戒指和一个磁铁戒指。从那以后我就一直戴着它们。^^但是，当我站在火山顶上的时候……我突然有了一个奇怪的想法。^^我拿出我的两个戒指，把它们扔进了锻造炉。^^天哪！它们合二为一了！^^现在我拥有了一个光辉磁铁戒指……我希望老父亲不会介意，愿他的灵魂安息……
1011.english: Day 37. When I was ten, my father gave me a glow ring and a magnet ring. I've worn them ever since. But when I stood on top of the volcano... I suddenly had a strange idea. I took out my two rings and threw them into the forge. My goodness! They merged into one! Now I own a glowstone magnet ring... I hope my old father won't mind, may his soul rest in peace...

12.chinese: 在走运的日子里，我在垃圾桶里找到了一些好东西。^^有时你会在星之果实餐吧的垃圾桶里找到“当日特供”……通常还很新鲜！^^至于甜点，我会翻翻乔治·莫尔纳家的垃圾桶，看看有没有饼干。^^珍宝的话，我会看看铁匠铺和博物馆旁的垃圾桶。
12.english: On lucky days, I find some good things in the trash cans. Sometimes you'll find the "daily special" in the Stardrop Saloon's trash can... usually still fresh! As for dessert, I'll rummage through George Molnar's family trash can to see if there are any cookies. For treasures, I'll look at the trash cans by the blacksmith and the museum.

13.chinese: ^^每个季节最后一天的中午 12 点整，检查一下游乐场上方的灌木丛吧。
13.english: At exactly 12 noon on the last day of each season, check the bushes above the playground.

14.chinese: ^^^    我在社区中心背面藏了些东西。
14.english: I hid something behind the Community Center.

24.chinese: 这是 M·贾思博的书中的一页：^^……这些生物，有一些人称之为“森林精灵”或是“祝尼魔”。据说它们会出现在废弃破败的建筑物之中。^^通常来说……当人类离开一个地方，大自然开始收回她的领土时，祝尼魔就一定会出现。^^民间传说认为，祝尼魔跟他们的小屋里放置的宝石会显示出某种共鸣关系……^^另外，据说他们最喜欢吃葡萄干，不过很腼腆，不敢直接从人的手上拿。^^当然，这些说法的来源都很可疑，未经验证……据我所知，甚至还没有任何实际证据表明这种生物确实存在！
24.english: This is a page from M. Jasper's book: ...These creatures, which some people call "forest spirits" or "Junimos", are said to appear in abandoned, dilapidated buildings. Generally speaking... when humans leave a place and nature begins to take back her territory, Junimos will surely appear. Folk legend holds that Junimos show some kind of resonant relationship with gems placed in their little huts... Also, it is said they like eating raisins most, but are very shy and don't dare take them directly from a person's hand. Of course, the sources of these claims are all very dubious and unverified... As far as I know, there isn't even any actual evidence showing this kind of creature really exists!

25.chinese: ^^我向妈妈借了一条项链，但在澡堂附近丢了……如果她发现项链不见了，肯定会大发雷霆！
25.english: I borrowed a necklace from Mom, but lost it near the bathhouse... If she discovers the necklace is missing, she'll definitely fly into a rage!

26.chinese: 《古代农耕秘辛》第 37 行：^^喂祝尼魔吃葡萄干，它们干起活来可带劲了……^^
26.english: "Secrets of Ancient Farming", line 37: Feed Junimos raisins, and they work with real gusto...

27.chinese: 亲爱的孩子：^你找到这张纸条的时候，想必已经在星露谷住了很长一段时间了吧。希望你的生活一切顺利！^星露谷对我来说是一个很亲切的地方……你能继承家里耕种的传统，用朴素的行动给这里带来生机和富饶，我感到非常光荣。^继续加油吧！^^——爷爷^^附：……我在山谷的某个地方给你留了一个特别的秘密，那里汇集了我找到的最厉害的东西。等你准备好的时候，自然会找到的。
27.english: Dear child: By the time you find this note, you have presumably already lived in Stardew Valley for a long time. I hope everything in your life goes smoothly! Stardew Valley is a very dear place to me... That you can carry on the family's farming tradition, and with simple actions bring vitality and abundance here, makes me feel very honored. Keep it up! —Grandpa. P.S. ...I left a special secret for you somewhere in the valley; gathered there are the most amazing things I found. When you are ready, you will naturally find it.

3.chinese: 这是莉亚的笔迹写的。^^我对完美晚餐的构想是沙拉、山羊乳酪、松露和果酒。至于甜点，我需要一个虞美人籽松糕。好吃！如果有人给我其中之一，我会很感动的。%revealtaste:Leah:196%revealtaste:Leah:426%revealtaste:Leah:430%revealtaste:Leah:348%revealtaste:Leah:651

7.chinese: 这是某人日记中的一页……^^……镇里只有少数几个“老”单身汉，他们都并不完美！哈维确实焦虑而软弱，但我知道他会成为一个忠诚专一的丈夫。他喜欢咖啡和腌菜。^^艾利欧特有些浮夸和矫情，但他的下巴确实很好看。他喜欢蟹黄糕和石榴。^^谢恩邋遢且反社会。但我认为他粗鲁的外在是一种保护机制，将他内心的柔软与世界隔离开来。他喜欢啤酒、披萨和爆炒青椒。%revealtaste:Harvey:395%revealtaste:Harvey:342%revealtaste:Elliott:732%revealtaste:Elliott:637%revealtaste:Shane:346%revealtaste:Shane:206%revealtaste:Shane:215
7.english: This is a page from someone's diary... ...There are only a small number of "old" bachelors in town, and none of them is perfect! Harvey is indeed anxious and weak, but I know he would become a loyal, devoted husband. He likes coffee and pickles. Elliott is somewhat pompous and affected, but his chin really is good-looking. He likes crab-roe cakes and pomegranates. Shane is sloppy and antisocial. But I think his rude exterior is a protective mechanism that isolates his inner softness from the world. He likes beer, pizza and stir-fried green peppers.

8.chinese: ^致海莉和艾米丽^^希望你们俩一切安好！给你们寄了最爱的礼物：海莉的粉红蛋糕和向日葵，艾米丽的宝石和动物毛！^^——爱你们的妈妈和爸爸。%revealtaste:Haley:221%revealtaste:Haley:421%revealtaste:Emily:440%revealtaste:Emily:66%revealtaste:Emily:62%revealtaste:Emily:60%revealtaste:Emily:70%revealtaste:Emily:64%revealtaste:Emily:68
